hooks.logic:
If the length of call helper3 with (this state) is more than 0, then choose state 14 next and stop.
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
Let part2 be part 4 of the acting enemy.
Let part3 be part 5 of the acting enemy.
If part2 is judged dead, then count up "turnsAfterMonkBDead".
If part3 is judged dead, then count up "turnsAfterKnightBDead".
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_ARAISE_DONE" is up this frame, then
  If part2 is alive, then reset the count "turnsAfterMonkBDead".
  If part3 is alive, then reset the count "turnsAfterKnightBDead".
Let bpConfsIndex be the register's 'bpConfsIndex'.
Let v be run helper.
If bpConfsIndex is not v, then
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form list2 at v's 'paramSuffixNo' on part.
  Set the register's 'bpConfsIndex' to v.
  Part changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  Part cancels its cast and stop.
If not the register's 'alreadyDispMessage', then
  If the HP fraction of part is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_disp_message" in the battle settings of the group of part, then
    Choose state 13 next.
    Set the register's 'alreadyDispMessage' to true and stop.
If part is ready to act, then
  Let number be the numeric entry "turns_of_araise_interval" in the battle settings of the group of part.
  If number is at most the count "turnsAfterMonkBDead", then
    Run helper2 on 4.
    Reset the count "turnsAfterMonkBDead" and stop.
  If number is at most the count "turnsAfterKnightBDead", then
    Run helper2 on 5.
    Reset the count "turnsAfterKnightBDead" and stop.
  Part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
